changes: Added secure provisioning of config.enc for Load Balancer nodes
Enhanced the module system with migration-based schema management, uninstall support, and event decoupling
Replaced the MaxMindDB PHP extension with a Composer-based pure PHP implementation
Added binary version and operating system information to the Settings page
Added a test stream generator for HTTP-served MP4 streams
Improved stream server stability with QuietThreadingHTTPServer
Improved Load Balancer installation by resetting binary ownership before PHP-FPM startup
Fixed EPG cache cleanup to remove only orphaned cache files
Fixed module manager method calls and bootstrap initialization issues
Improved GitHub update reliability with increased API timeouts
Restored correct ownership of config.enc and install_id during provisioning
Optimized FFmpeg command generation for better streaming performance
Fixed BruteforceGuard integer handling and corrected documentation examples
Introduced centralized database access through DatabaseAware and dedicated wiring classes
Refactored multiple services for improved readability, maintainability, and cleaner architecture
Added a CLAUDE.md project guide and updated backup and migration documentation
